# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It adds variable and color fonts, animated WebP encoding, a Graphite-ready singleton lifecycle rework, and new Vulkan interop types, alongside several native dependency updates. This is a breaking release — read the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped and lost value-equality** — The property is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (was GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo), and the type no longer implements IEquatable or the == / != operators. Compare fields directly instead of using equality operators.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose lost its setter** — The property is now get-only. Code that assigned it must remove the assignment; the value is now controlled internally.
- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface instead of a lazy default** — new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty instead of null, so MeasureText on an unset font returns 0. Construct with new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default) to get the old behavior, and check font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of comparing to null. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735))
- **new SKPaint().Typeface now returns Default instead of null** — Text still draws and measures correctly, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect an unset typeface no longer fires. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty, or drop the check since a usable default is always present. ([#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName never returns null, even on Android** — All platforms now consistently fall back to SKTypeface.Default for an unmatched family name. For a strict "was it found" check, call SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) instead, which still returns null on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete** — The overload previously silently truncated offsets larger than int.MaxValue; it now throws OverflowException for out-of-range values and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range, validated offset instead. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))

## Engine

- **Skia bumped to milestone m148** — Moves through Skia milestones 132, 133, and 147 before landing on m148, merging several rounds of upstream bug fixes along the way. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable and color font support added** — Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, plus color font palette support and improved variable font robustness. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream access** — Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP, and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions support extended** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HarfBuzz HBColor struct and API cleanup** — Adds an HBColor struct for hb_color_t, plus missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Legacy paint/text obsoletes promoted to errors** — Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs, including legacy paint text/font state members, are now compile errors rather than warnings. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel access corrected** — SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for the generic offset overload. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash fixed** — Fixes a crash when SKPathBuilder is garbage-collected before the SKPath it produced. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **WinUI and MAUI rendering fixes** — Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers, and SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in MAUI's TabBar. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084), [#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how SkiaSharp's singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **New native targets and TFM fixes** — Adds Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native asset support, drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten/WASM, and fixes Apple TFMs to use 26.0 for libraries and unversioned TFMs for apps. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022), [#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates zlib, libpng, libexpat/expat, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz to their latest patched versions. ([#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Adds an HBColor struct for proper color representation, variable-font shaping support, missing API wrappers, and naming-convention fixes, while bumping the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
